summary.text: Shane Stoneman is the Republican candidate for Delaware House of Representatives District 7 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democratic incumbent Larry Lambert.
He was also the Republican candidate for the seat in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Shane Stoneman first ran for District 7 in 2022, losing to incumbent Larry Lambert 71.3% to 28.7%.
He ran again in 2024 and lost to Lambert 70.3% to 29.7%.
